outcome: Amounts on the invoice PDF and the dashboard are shown with thousands separators, so a customer reads 1,234.56 rather than 1234.56.

acceptance_criteria.text: formatMoney renders thousands separators: 123456 minor units render as 1,234.56 and 100000000 as 1,000,000.00.
Every existing caller of formatMoney keeps working, and every package's tests pass.

expected_verification.assertion: vitest run across every package passes

data_impact: None. Amounts stay integer minor units in storage; only the rendered string changes.
rollout: Ships with the format package; callers pick it up at their next build.
rollback: git revert restores the plain rendering.
